runtime.why: 1.13.8 is the last release that turns text into sounds for Piper, Kitten and Kokoro voices by itself; 2.0.0 removed that.

piper-id.name: Piper news_tts
piper-id.licence: No licence is documented for this voice. Its model card says "License: See URL" and the URL is an unrelated Kaggle notebook; it was fine-tuned from the lessac voice, whose recordings are licensed for research only; and Piper's own commercial-use list leaves it out. Its name matches the Indonesian News TTS recordings (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), which the card does not confirm. Program: sherpa-onnx, Apache-2.0.

notice.en: ElevenLabs' free plan is for non-commercial use only and needs "elevenlabs.io" in the title; videos you sell or make for a client need a paid plan.

elevenlabs.licence: ElevenLabs Terms of Service (updated 9 October 2026): a free user "may only use the Services for non-commercial purposes"; a paid user may use them commercially. Its help centre adds that free-plan content, when published, must carry "elevenlabs.io" or "11.ai" in the title. Free plan: 10,000 credits a month (about 10 minutes of speech); Starter: 6 US dollars a month, 30,000 credits, commercial licence.
